description: This file defines the ObserverGrain class, which implements observer pattern interfaces and methods to subscribe to an observable grain, set targets, and propagate state changes within an Orleans-based grain system.

classes.name: ObserverGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing observer pattern, allowing subscriptions and state change notifications.

methods.name: SetTarget
methods.description: Sets the target observable grain and subscribes to its notifications.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Allows an observer to subscribe to this grain.

methods.name: StateChanged
methods.description: Called to propagate state changes to the observer.
